instagram.caption:
The EU’s new AI rules only hit the most powerful models—most tools you use daily aren’t covered yet. 🎯

OpenAI just aligned its safety practices with the EU’s tiered AI Act, but the plan leaves enforcement vague. Audits are promised, but no one knows how they’ll actually run. Smaller models could slip through—for now.

If you build or publish with AI, expect more oversight on your bigger deployments, and soon. The gap won’t last.
